statements.t: Sales from fast growth markets were approximately $78 million this quarter, and we are now on track to exceed $315 million in fiscal year 2027.
Considering first quarter results and our expanding backlog, we are raising our fiscal year 2027 outlook based on multiple growth engines.”
In fiscal second quarter 2027, on a year-on-year basis, the Company expects moderately higher revenue and adjusted operating margin.
On a sequential basis, the Company expects slightly higher revenue and similar adjusted operating margin.
For fiscal year 2027, the Company is raising its outlook to high-single digits total sales growth, from mid-to-high single digits previously.
The Company now anticipates organic sales to increase by more than $100 million in fiscal year 2027.
The Company expects higher sales and adjusted operating margin expansion to drive high teens growth in adjusted earnings per share.
The Company is on track to release more than 20 new products, which are expected to contribute more than 300 bps of incremental growth.
In fiscal second quarter 2027, on a sequential basis, the Company expects slightly higher revenue and similar adjusted operating margin.
On a year-on-year basis, the Company expects significantly higher revenue and slightly higher adjusted operating margin.
In fiscal second quarter 2027, on a sequential basis, the Company expects significantly higher revenue and slightly higher adjusted operating margin.
In fiscal second quarter 2027, on a sequential basis, the Company expects similar to slightly higher revenue and similar adjusted operating margin.
In fiscal second quarter 2027, on a sequential basis, the Company expects slightly lower revenue and adjusted operating margin.
